## Every Major Commercial Real Estate Brokerage in Canada Subscribes to CoStar


September 30, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.costargroup.com/node/17456/pdf)


*Industry-wide adoption underscores CoSta* *r’* *s role as Canada* *’* *s standard for comprehensive commercial real estate data, analytics and tools that help professionals compete and deliver greater value to clients*


TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 30, 2026-- CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP), a leading provider of commercial real estate information, analytics and online marketplaces in the property markets, today announced that every major commercial real estate brokerage firm in Canada subscribes to CoStar. Across the industry, leading national and global firms use CoStar’s property data, analytics and market intelligence to support their Canadian operations, compete more effectively and strengthen the advice they provide to clients.


By bringing detailed property, ownership, tenant, transaction, availability, news and market information together in one platform, CoStar helps brokerage professionals spend less time gathering data and more time uncovering opportunities, preparing stronger pitches, advancing transactions and advising clients. Its broad adoption also gives firms a consistent foundation for comparing markets, properties and opportunities across Canada.


"Canada’s leading commercial real estate brokerages recognize that direct access to comprehensive, reliable market information is essential to competing effectively and delivering excellent client service," said **Andy Florance, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of CoStar Group** . "We are proud to support every major brokerage firm in Canada with the data, analytics and tools their professionals need to identify opportunities, act with confidence and deliver stronger outcomes for clients."


CoStar’s Canadian platform includes intelligence on 357,000 commercial properties, 136,000 sale comparables, 211,000 lease activities, 500,000 tenant profiles, 27,000 active listings and 12 billion square feet of space. This depth and breadth help brokers identify prospective owners, tenants, buyers and sellers; strengthen listing presentations and client recommendations; and evaluate opportunities using current market evidence. Research and valuation professionals can reduce manual data collection, create reports more efficiently and devote more time to analysis and strategic advice.


**About CoStar Group**


CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a global leader in commercial real estate information, analytics, online marketplaces, and 3D digital twin technology. Founded in 1986, CoStar Group is dedicated to digitizing the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights, and connections that improve their businesses and lives.


CoStar Group’s major brands include CoStar, a leading global provider of commercial real estate data, analytics, and news; LoopNet, the most trafficked commercial real estate marketplace; Apartments.com, the leading platform for apartment rentals; Homes.com, the fastest-growing residential real estate marketplace; and Domain, one of Australia’s leading property marketplaces. CoStar Group’s industry-leading brands also include Matterport, a leading spatial data company whose platform turns buildings into data to make every space more valuable and accessible; STR, a global leader in hospitality data and benchmarking; Zonda, a leading provider of data, analytics, software, and marketplace solutions for the residential construction industry; Ten-X, an online platform for commercial real estate auctions and negotiated bids; and OnTheMarket, a leading residential property portal in the United Kingdom.


CoStar Group’s websites attracted over 118 million average monthly unique visitors in the second quarter of 2026, serving clients around the world. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, CoStar Group is committed to transforming the real estate industry through innovative technology and comprehensive market intelligence. From time to time, we plan to utilize our corporate website as a channel of distribution for material company information.
